method: Opened the three canonical PNGs directly with view_image; observations derive from their pixels, not from author object lists.

inventory: One narrow outlined vertical plate at the left, extending across the ray bundle.
Seven approximately vertical, evenly spaced straight wavefront strokes to the right of the plate.
Five approximately horizontal, parallel rays running from the plate through every front to rightward arrowheads.
The wavefronts are perpendicular to the rays; ray/front crossings are not marked points.
No letters, numbers, ticks, dimensions, axes, or extra subfigures.
One shallow rectangular tray viewed obliquely, with a rear rim, two slanted side rims, a broad near wall, and small dark feet below.
One long narrow rod across the near-left portion of the water surface; a handle joins it from the left and crosses the left tray rim.
A visible inner surface boundary distinct from the tray rim and the near outer wall.
Sixteen repeated surface-front strokes traverse the water surface roughly parallel to the rod, with some left-side portions obscured by the rod/handle.
The front strokes bend slightly and remain confined to the water surface; they are not rays or a measured grid.
No source labels, numeric values, ticks, arrows, or extra apparatus.
One finite dark circular source at the common center, with a small white highlight.
Four solid concentric circular fronts surrounding the source, at approximately equal radial intervals.
One smaller dashed concentric circle around the source, inside the first solid front.
Eight straight radial spokes, approximately cardinal and diagonal, continuing through the fronts to outward arrowheads.
All circles share the source center; the spokes are normal to the fronts where they cross.
No letters, numbers, labels, angle marks, radius values, or additional subfigures.

scopeNote: These are schematic pixel observations, not measurements of physical distances. Front counts and visible apparatus are recorded explicitly; no invisible component is assumed.
